text: Also, one thing to tag on there, some roads are not showing up in my roads placed menu [Image #4]
resolution: Root-caused the ghost: the Effect GPU data buffer never shrinks (framework/gpu/effects.zig grows capacity only) and the ribbon shader gates on arrayLength(&D) = bind-group capacity. roadRibbonSection encoded 'no roads' by OMITTING the section, so deleting a road uploaded shorter data and the old ribbon section stayed alive in the buffer tail — the deleted road kept rendering while menu/state/disk were correctly empty. Your eventlog shows 6 rapid deletes at 08:15:59-08:16:01: each delete looked like it did nothing (ghost stayed), so repeat clicks silently ate the rest of the roster as rows re-flowed. Fix: the 5-float section header is now ALWAYS emitted with segN=0 when empty, overwriting the slot; shared encoder covers the 2D chunk quads and the 3D drape. Test guard added, roadData 23/23 green. Strokes deleted at 08:16 are genuinely gone (undercoat restored the ground correctly) and need redrawing.
